coverage_note: The supplied text covers the full article. Supplements and figure pixels were unavailable; the finding relies on explicit main-text participant counts.

findings.candidate_quote: The 12-week randomized, placebo-controlled trial involved 44 participants, with 19 receiving the fiber mixture and 23 receiving maltodextrin as a placebo.
findings.reference_quote:
leaving a total of 44 participants to be randomized to one of the intervention arms (fiber n = 21; placebo
n = 23). After two dropouts in each group, 19 and 21 participants completed the fiber and placebo intervention,
respectively
findings.explanation: The summary mixes the fiber group's completer count with the placebo group's randomized count. Of 44 randomized participants, 21 were assigned fiber and 23 placebo; 19 and 21, respectively, completed the intervention. The stated 19/23 allocation is incorrect and does not total 44.
